observations: Host load during this round: 97-118 (round 1: 32-46). At that load the real OMP probe takes 4.3-10.4 s, so the recipe's literal 5 s budget never lets the real probe through; the launch proof therefore used 20 s (the hang attempts still time out at the limit; the 10 s / 20 s waits are unchanged). The 5 s run is kept as the host-load exercise: 400 s of capped-backoff retries with the API up, zero panes, process alive.

Finding (low): a probe attempt that is IN FLIGHT when a pre-hold boot failure exits the process leaves its child running — the runner's kill timer dies with the daemon (variant B: `sleep 60` pid 604497 alive 45 s after exit 1). The abort covers the pending backoff (proven, variant A), not the running attempt. Under a supervisor loop on a pre-hold failure this is one orphaned OMP probe per relaunch for up to the probe's own runtime. Suggested: kill the in-flight runner child on abort (pass the AbortSignal into defaultRunner / proc.kill() on abort) or have startDaemon's catch await the probe chain's settlement before rejecting.

Both negative controls first died on `worker_stream_port 19391 ... EADDRINUSE` (an unrelated bun process took 19391 between rounds) — an accidental extra pre-hold-failure sample: exit 1 within 2 s, 0 `retrying in`, lock released; the negatives were rerun on 19400/19401.

observations: Host load during this round: 97-118 (round 1: 32-46). At that load the real OMP probe takes 4.3-10.4 s, so the recipe's literal 5 s budget never lets the real probe through; the launch proof therefore used 20 s (the hang attempts still time out at the limit; the 10 s / 20 s waits are unchanged). The 5 s run is kept as the host-load exercise: 400 s of capped-backoff retries with the API up, zero panes, process alive.

Finding (low): a probe attempt that is IN FLIGHT when a pre-hold boot failure exits the process leaves its child running — the runner's kill timer dies with the daemon (variant B: `sleep 60` pid 604497 alive 45 s after exit 1). The abort covers the pending backoff (proven, variant A), not the running attempt. Under a supervisor loop on a pre-hold failure this is one orphaned OMP probe per relaunch for up to the probe's own runtime. Suggested: kill the in-flight runner child on abort (pass the AbortSignal into defaultRunner / proc.kill() on abort) or have startDaemon's catch await the probe chain's settlement before rejecting.

Both negative controls first died on `worker_stream_port 19391 ... EADDRINUSE` (an unrelated bun process took 19391 between rounds) — an accidental extra pre-hold-failure sample: exit 1 within 2 s, 0 `retrying in`, lock released; the negatives were rerun on 19400/19401.
